method: Integrator's correction pass, applied by research/risk-debate/audit-fixes.mjs after reconcile.mjs. Each proposed quotation was checked against the cached source with the pack's own quoteFound before it was applied; merge and verify then report no quote, budget, role, earliest-located or loaded-word problems. One entry per audit finding with a verdict other than ok, per wording item and per pack-wide finding. Ids are the audit's; where this pass changed an id, the note names the new one.

(document bengio-2023-managing-extreme-risks and source takeoff-bengio-2023-managing-extreme-risks into bengio-2023-managing-ai-risks; both cache files have the same SHA-256), Narayanan and Kapoor (into narayanan-kapoor-2025-normal-technology), Brooks 2014 (one document brooks-2014-tool-not-threat with two sources, Robohub and Edge, both carrying quotations). No two records then shared text, proposition and stance, so no records were merged. Per-source quotation budgets re-checked by verify.
